clubs.name: Hyderabad Runners Club
clubs.tagline: Run Together. Grow Stronger. Hyderabad’s Active Distance Community.
clubs.description: Hyderabad's most vibrant running collective, welcoming everyone from first-time 5K joggers to seasoned marathoners. We organize scenic sunrise loops around KBR National Park, interval speed sessions, and long weekend pacing runs.
clubs.meetingPoint: Main Entrance Gate, KBR National Park, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad
rules: Carry your own reusable hydration bottle — zero littering on city park trails
Wear reflective clothing or headlamps for sessions starting before 6:00 AM
Encourage fellow runners across all paces (walk-runners always welcome)
Notify session leads in advance if taking an alternative route
communityGuidelines: Inclusivity is our core value. Pace shaming of any kind is strictly prohibited.
Check in with session pacers before departure so no one is left behind.
Safety first: maintain awareness of morning traffic on outer park loops.

clubs.name: Cyberabad Cycling Club
clubs.tagline: Two Wheels, One City. Morning Rides across Telangana’s Scenic Corridors.
clubs.description: Hyderabad's premier cycling community connecting roadies, gravel grinders, and hybrid commuters. From brisk dawn spins through the Financial District to scenic endurance journeys out to Gandipet and Ananthagiri.
rules: Helmets are 100% mandatory — no helmet, no ride
Front white headlight and rear flashing red light required for dawn/night rides
Obey traffic lights and follow ride marshalls in single-file or two-abreast formation
communityGuidelines: Ride at a safe following distance and signal road hazards to riders behind.
Mechanical assistance: members carry spare tubes; we stop to help any stranded rider.

clubs.name: Smashers Badminton Club
clubs.tagline: Competitive Rallies & Social Doubles for Hyderabad Shuttlers.
clubs.description: Connecting passionate badminton players in Gachibowli, Madhapur, and Kondapur. We host weekly round-robin doubles scrimmages, inter-club tournaments, and coaching clinics on tournament-grade wooden courts.
clubs.meetingPoint: Pullela Gopichand Badminton Academy, ISB Road, Gachibowli
rules: Non-marking badminton court shoes strictly required at all partnered venues
Tournament-grade nylon or feather shuttles provided for official sessions
Warm up properly before matches to prevent court floor injuries
communityGuidelines: Rotate court partners after each 21-point set to ensure balanced playing time.
Respect line calls and maintain high sportsmanship standards.

clubs.name: FitFolk Outdoor Bootcamp & Mobility
clubs.tagline: Functional Strength, Calisthenics & Movement under the Hyderabad Sky.
clubs.description: Ditch the enclosed gym walls! We train in Hyderabad's scenic urban parks using bodyweight calisthenics, resistance bands, agility ladders, and primal movement drills for everyday athletic conditioning.
clubs.meetingPoint: Durgam Cheruvu Lakefront Amphitheatre, Madhapur, Hyderabad
rules: Bring a standard exercise yoga mat and personal towel
Disclose any prior joint injuries to coaches prior to session commencement
communityGuidelines: All fitness levels are accommodated with scaled exercise progressions.
Focus on technique and movement form before increasing reps or speed.

clubs.name: Hyderabad Social Sports & Bouldering Club
clubs.tagline: Recreational Games, Hill Scrambles & Post-Match Cafés.
clubs.description: Connecting working professionals and sports newcomers across twin cities. We do weekend bouldering scrambles around Khajaguda hills, fun frisbee & dodgeball games, and friendly board-game socials.
clubs.meetingPoint: Khajaguda Rock Heritage Site, Gachibowli-Kondapur link road
rules: Sturdy trail running shoes or hiking boots recommended for rock terrain
Keep group together — trail marshalls lead and sweep every excursion
Zero alcohol, smoking, or littering on natural heritage rocks
communityGuidelines: Beginners are paired with experienced scramblers on natural trails.
Join for the coffee and breakfast conversations after each outing.

events.title: Sunrise 10K & 5K Guided Trail Loop
events.description: Join our signature weekend morning run around the scenic shaded perimeter of KBR National Park. Pacers available for 5:30 min/km, 6:00 min/km, 6:30 min/km, and 7:00 min/km (walk-jog group). Free community event with hydration provided at the halfway mark.
events.address: Opposite TDP Office, Road No. 2, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad
events.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation anytime. Please cancel at least 2 hours prior if unable to attend so waitlisted runners can join.
events.equipmentRequirements: Running shoes, personal hydration flask, light breathable sportswear

events.title: Half-Marathon Pacing Run & Nutrition Clinic
events.description: Structured 16K/21K endurance run covering Durgam Cheruvu Cable Bridge and Financial District. Includes electrolytes, energy gels, support vehicle, and post-run recovery smoothies.
events.venueName: Durgam Cheruvu Viewpoint to Financial District
events.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 24 hours before the event. Speedcat demo platform fee clearly detailed at booking.
events.equipmentRequirements: Distance running shoes, hydration vest or waist pack

events.title: Saturday 40K Sunrise Ride to Gandipet Lake
events.description: Brisk morning group pedal departing Gachibowli through Shankarpally highway up to Osman Sagar / Gandipet Lake promenade. Regroup points at every 10km.
events.venueName: Bio-Diversity Junction to Osman Sagar Lake
events.address: Bio-Diversity Junction, Old Mumbai Highway, Hyderabad
events.cancellationPolicy: Free registration. Please notify on group chat if you cannot make it.
events.equipmentRequirements: Bicycle (road/hybrid/MTB), helmet (mandatory), spare tube, front & rear lights

events.title: Night Neon Urban Ride: HITEC City & Cable Bridge
events.description: Experience Hyderabad under the illuminated city lights! 25km safe urban night circuit with marshall pilot, mechanical backup vehicle, and post-ride chai stop.
events.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 12 hours prior to start. Platform fee waived on demo cancellation.
events.equipmentRequirements: Working front & rear lights, helmet, neon/reflective band

events.title: Wednesday Evening Doubles League & Round Robin
events.description: 2.5 hours of non-stop competitive badminton doubles at Gopichand Academy Teak Wood courts. Fixed partnerships or randomized pairings available. Mavis 350 shuttles provided.
events.cancellationPolicy: Refundable up to 6 hours before slot. Court reservation cost split included.
events.equipmentRequirements: Non-marking court shoes strictly required, bring personal racquets

events.title: Sunday Lakeside Sunrise HIIT & Core Blast
events.description: Full-body bodyweight conditioning, animal flow mobility, and partner agility circuits overlooking Durgam Cheruvu lake. Free open session for all fitness levels.
events.cancellationPolicy: Free registration. Please cancel if not attending.
events.equipmentRequirements: Workout mat, sports towel, water bottle

events.title: Khajaguda Rock Scramble & Sunset Social
events.description: Guided bouldering scramble across Khajaguda's natural granite formations followed by chai and snacks. Easy to intermediate scrambling routes with spotters.
events.address: Near Khajaguda Lake, Kondapur-Gachibowli Link, Hyderabad
events.cancellationPolicy: Free social activity. Notify host if running late.
events.equipmentRequirements: Grippy sport shoes, cap, water bottle
